entries.name: nullable_nonnull_type_distinction
entries.guard: static null analysis is not a universal runtime guarantee; reject unproven external interop and unsafe assertions

entries.name: explicit_bitstring_pattern_matching
entries.guard: fixed input and fixed width/endianness/signedness are required; malformed input must return a structured rejection

entries.name: automatic_reference_counting
entries.guard: weak and unsafe references, autorelease/runtime behavior, ABI, and resource finalization boundaries require evidence

entries.name: compile_time_string_format_types
entries.guard: type-level pattern constraints do not validate arbitrary dynamic strings; runtime canonical validation remains required

entries.name: effect_ordering_witness
entries.guard: sequence composition may be specified, but external IO, scheduler, filesystem, and network outcomes remain unproven

entries.name: deep_compile_time_constant
entries.guard: constant value and identity require a specified backend/runtime; immutability does not prove universal canonical ABI behavior
